tile_replacement.permission_required: Tile replacement requires a confirmed virtual map edit request.
tile_replacement.scope_unavailable: This native replacement route supports one Neutral completed Tile replaced by GasPermeableMembrane in the active world.
tile_replacement.target_unverifiable: The exact completed Tile identity, geometry or native registration could not be verified.
tile_replacement.target_changed: The original Tile, game context or native replacement candidate changed; no further action was issued.
tile_replacement.candidate_rejected: The native replacement candidate or CanReplace result does not match the exact completed Tile.
tile_replacement.pending_conflict: The replacement layer already contains a different or unverifiable reservation.
tile_replacement.marked_work_conflict: The original Tile has deconstruction, reconstruction or dig work that native replacement could cancel; replacement was refused.
tile_replacement.instant_mode_enabled: Native tile replacement requires both debug instant build and sandbox instant build to be off.
tile_replacement.ui_unavailable: The normal native building UI is unavailable for tile replacement.
tile_replacement.ui_busy: Another tool, drag, modal or UI owner is active; tile replacement was refused.
tile_replacement.ui_initializing: The normal material or priority UI has not completed natural initialization; no build gesture was issued.
tile_replacement.preview_unavailable: The native preview, ordered material selection or priority does not match the requested replacement.
tile_replacement.priority_unavailable: The requested normal building priority could not be read or applied through the native priority UI.
tile_replacement.native_failed: The normal native tile replacement entry point failed; inspect the observed state before issuing another request.
tile_replacement.cleanup_failed: The native build preview could not be safely verified as returned to the selection tool.
tile_replacement.priority_restore_failed: The original native screen priority could not be safely restored without overwriting another UI owner.
tile_replacement.queue_not_observed: No verified native tile replacement reservation was observed; the native void entry point does not expose a refusal reason.
tile_replacement.observation_unavailable: Tile replacement outcome observation is unavailable; changed and applied values remain unknown.
tile_replacement.protected_state_changed: The original Tile or another protected occupant changed unexpectedly; no restoration or retry was attempted.
